text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia (low oxygen saturation), leukopenia, lymphopenia, neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated monocytes, eosinophils, and basophils. These findings suggest possible bone marrow suppression or infiltration, or a severe systemic/infectious process. Red cell indices and chemistry are within normal limits. Immediate clinical correlation and further investigation are strongly recommended.
